Pochtli [FN]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Giovanni
Capacity: 8
Discipline: cel dom NEC OBF POT
Independent: Pochtli may move up to two cards from your ash heap to your
library as a +1 stealth action. Shuffle your library afterward.

LSJ has said that there is only one "ash heap". Since Pochtli does not
limit himself to the type of card, what happens if you use his ability to
put a burned Vampire from your ash heap into your Library? Can you draw
a Vampire card? Can you do anything with it from your hand?

Similarly, you cannot move library cards to your crypt.

> ashheap are vampires? Can he not take the action? Can he take the

Same thing that happens if there are no cards in your ash heap, yes.
If there are no library cards in your ash heap, then effects which would
move library cards from your ash heap to your library will have nothing
to target. With no target, the card/action cannot be played/performed.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Roger Carhult wrote:
> How is the Coven ruled if I have no minions, can I still tap it to
> keep my predator from using it twice that round?

No. You also could not, say, tap KRCG in response to a Dominate Kine
action directed at it (unless Anneke or an Eagle's Sight was played
by someone else to attempt to block the action and you felt like
paying a pool to distribute the intercept).

Look at your own original question.

"If I have NO MINIONS"... then no, you couldn't tap KRCG to give a
minion you control intercept. And you couldn't tap the Coven. And you
couldn't give ANOTHER minion intercept unless they were trying to block.

The basic idea is that if you can't find a target, you can't use the
effect. Coven requires a ready vampire, so with no ready vampires, you
can't tap it. Fast Hands requires your opponent to have equipment; if
they don't have equipment, you can't play Fast Hands.

>Can you tap the Coven to give blodd to an already full vampire then?
>(this I think you can but it will just drain off).

Yes.
